evidence_boundaries: PQ66 is independently documented as an acquisition point and Basic Reward for Candy Beam.
PQ113 also lists Candy Beam as a Basic Reward; this later Extra Pack 1 context is preserved in source_parallel_quests without replacing the base-game PQ66 anchor.
Community reports about Ultimate-Finish attempts and RNG do not establish a mandatory Ultimate Finish gate or drop probability.
